edges.reason: Fallback function reads msg.sender for the Deposit event.
onlyWallet modifier compares msg.sender with address(this).
ownerExists modifier validates msg.sender against isOwner/delayedOwner.
submitTransaction is restricted by ownerExists(msg.sender).
confirmTransaction is restricted by ownerExists and branches on msg.sender == delayedOwner.
executeTransaction is restricted by ownerExists(msg.sender) and confirmed(transactionId, msg.sender).
confirmed modifier compares delayedConfirmations[transactionId] with block timestamp (now).
Delayed confirmation timestamp is written from now + 2 weeks.
confirmTransaction writes delayedConfirmations using the block timestamp.
isConfirmed validates delayedConfirmations[transactionId] < now to count the delayed owner.

normalization_plan.reason: Constructor parameter _owners only feeds the constructor's owner initialization logic.
Constructor parameter _delayedOwner is only assigned to delayedOwner inside the constructor.
owner parameter is only used inside replaceOwner for the swap and modifier checks.
newOwner parameter is only used inside replaceOwner when rewriting the owners array.
destination is only forwarded from submitTransaction to addTransaction.
value is only forwarded from submitTransaction to addTransaction.
data is only forwarded from submitTransaction to addTransaction.
transactionId is only used inside confirmTransaction for confirmation bookkeeping.
transactionId selects the transaction whose value/data is used in the low-level call.
transactionId is only used inside isConfirmed to index confirmations and delayedConfirmations.
destination is only used to build the new Transaction struct in addTransaction.
value is only used to build the new Transaction struct in addTransaction.
data is only used to build the new Transaction struct in addTransaction.
from only bounds the returned slice in getTransactionIds.
to only bounds the returned slice in getTransactionIds.
pending is only used as a filter flag in getTransactionIds.
executed is only used as a filter flag in getTransactionIds.
_length is a temporary cache of _owners.length inside the constructor.
i is only the constructor loop index over initial owners.
i is only the owners scan index inside replaceOwner.
transactionId is the local return value produced and consumed by submitTransaction.
txn storage pointer supplies destination, value and data to the low-level call.
count is only the confirmation tally local to isConfirmed.
i is only the owners loop index inside isConfirmed.
transactionIdsTemp is only the in-memory buffer used by getTransactionIds.
count is only the buffer cursor local to getTransactionIds.
i is only the loop index used by getTransactionIds.
_transactionIds is only the local return array of getTransactionIds.
